name: torch.load without weights_only=True
attack_scenario: Attacker publishes a fine-tuned model on a hub; torch.load("pytorch_model.bin") deserializes an embedded __reduce__ that spawns a reverse shell during load, before any inference runs.
negative_test_hint: load a checkpoint carrying a malicious __reduce__ via "torch.load('evil_model.pt')" and assert loading refuses it or runs with weights_only=True so no code executes

exemplar.compliant:
from safetensors.torch import load_file
model = load_file("model.safetensors")
exemplar.explanation: A .pt/.pth checkpoint is a pickle; torch.load unpickles it and runs any __reduce__ payload it carries, so a poisoned model file executes code on load. weights_only=True (default flips to True only in torch>=2.6) or safetensors is the safe form.
